title: polyDegreeLt is a PROPOSITION, deliberately not a computed degree
statement: Complex.polyDegreeLt c n : Prop asserts every coefficient of c at index >= n is Complex.Equiv-zero. This is deliberately a PROPOSITION about the coefficient function, NOT a computed degree: Complex.Equiv is undecidable on this quotient-free constructed carrier, so no coefficient can be tested for zero and no numeric degree can be extracted as data. It exists purely to state and use degree HYPOTHESES in later theorems (polyDegreeLt_polyAdd, polyDegreeLt_polyScale, polyEval_polyMul).
